metrics.formula: Group qualifying official Grand Prix wins by entity and Grand Prix name, then count or sum each group.
metrics.zeroRowPolicy: Exclude all-zero ranking rows; retain zero values only when they are required evidence inside a qualifying detail series.
metrics.nullabilityPolicy: Ranking identity, rank and value are never null; unavailable optional evidence stays explicitly null and never becomes zero.
metrics.eventEligibility: Formula 1 World Championship Grand Prix classifications only; Sprints are excluded
metrics.grandPrixSprintTreatment: Grand Prix only; Sprint results are excluded unless the statistic is explicitly a Sprint statistic
metrics.entryStartTreatment: Uses classification participation; start-sensitive formulas are externally blocked when attribution is unknown
metrics.sharedDriveTreatment: A credited driver result counts for each named driver; constructor car-entry facts are deduplicated by sharedDriveGroupId
metrics.tiesAndRanking: Deterministic competition ranking; equal values share rank and the next rank skips accordingly

presentationContract.emptyFieldBehaviour: Omit an optional column when every row is empty; a required field may never be blank.

customTable.exclusionReason: Metric returns entity-group rows rather than exactly one row per entity.
